headline: {KeyWord:Fraser Yachts Monaco}
primaryText: Fraser Monaco office is home to a dedicated team, in the heart of Monaco's Port Hercules.
whyItWorks: Striking sunset photos of a superyacht and a speeding yacht signal luxury and place the brand in an aspirational setting before any text is read. The local Monaco address and the Website, Call and Directions buttons give high-intent searchers several easy ways to make contact. The unfilled template placeholders in the headline suggest a sloppy setup, but the ad was still being shown recently.
